pgid.description: The process group to signal. Absent or zero means the session's own group, which is the shell. A named group is the addressee a stop ladder resolved once — from this session's foreground group as its inventory entry reports it — and keeps for the whole escalation, so a shell that starts another job between SIGINT and SIGKILL is not hit by the second. It grants the caller nothing it did not already have: reaching this service means having authenticated as the account that owns the helper, and that account may call kill(2) on the same group directly.
